name: Amazon SES
free: No permanent free tier. New AWS customers get up to $200 in Free Tier credits that can apply to SES (per the SES pricing page).
notes: Since Jul 21, 2026, new SES accounts (and account-region pairs with no metered SES use since Jun 1, 2025) start on the Essentials plan at $0.16 per 1,000 emails. A la carte pricing is $0.10 per 1,000 and can be chosen at any time.
Attachment data is billed at $0.12 per GB on top of the per-email rate.
Pro plan adds a $105 per account per region monthly fee; Enterprise adds $500.

name: Resend
free: Free: 3,000 emails a month, capped at 100 a day.
notes: Dedicated IP is a $30/mo add-on on Scale, for senders above 3,000 emails a day.
Monthly billing only; no annual discount on self-serve plans.

name: Postmark
free: Free developer plan: 100 emails a month, no overages, never expires.
notes: Tiers read from the pricing calculator on postmarkapp.com (Basic, Pro, Platform at 10k, 50k, 125k, 300k, 700k and 1.5M).
Dedicated IPs start at $50/mo per IP, for senders of 300,000+ emails a month on Pro or higher.
Bootstrapped companies can ask support for $75 in account credit (per the pricing FAQ).

name: Twilio SendGrid
free: Free trial only: 100 emails a day for 60 days.
notes: Only the entry prices are published as text: Essentials from $19.95/mo, Pro from $89.95/mo. Other tier prices sit behind the volume slider and were not readable, so larger volumes use the entry tier plus its published overage rate and may overstate cost.
Published overage per extra email: Essentials 50K $0.0013, Essentials 100K $0.0009, Pro 100K $0.0011, Pro 300K $0.0009, Pro 700K $0.0008, Pro 1.5M $0.0006, Pro 2.5M $0.0005.
Pro includes 1 dedicated IP.

name: Mailgun
free: Free: 100 emails a day, 1 custom domain, 1 day of logs.
notes: Entry tiers only (Basic 10k, Foundation 50k, Scale 100k). Larger tiers sit behind the volume slider and were not readable, so larger volumes use the entry tier plus its published overage rate and may overstate cost.
Foundation and Scale are free for the first month.
Extra dedicated IPs are $59/IP/mo; one is included with Foundation 100k, Growth and Scale.

name: MailerSend
free: Free: 500 emails a month, 1 domain, 100 API requests a day.
notes: Monthly prices from the pricing calculator; paying yearly saves 10%.
Hobby is $7/mo monthly ($5.60/mo billed yearly) for 5,000 emails.

name: Mailtrap
free: Free: 4,000 emails a month, capped at 150 a day.
notes: Email Live Sending prices, billed monthly (yearly saves up to 20%).
Overage is $1.00/1k on Basic, $0.88 on Business, $0.55 on Enterprise, but Mailtrap caps overage per plan without publishing the cap, so totals here only use a tier whose quota covers the volume.

name: SMTP2GO
notes: Only the Starter 10k and Professional 100k tiers were readable; larger volumes use those tiers plus the published overage and may overstate cost.
Paying yearly gives 2 months free.
Professional includes a dedicated IP.
